newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds and futures ended firmer, led higher by government bonds that posted gains of up to 3/8 point. Buying interest stemmed in part from next Monday's expiry of the September CONF contract.
Open interest dwindled to just over 7,000 contracts.
Domestic bonds remained the centre of attention. Dealers were watching closely the expected launch on Wednesday of a 550 million franc Pfandbriefzentrale bond.
"This bond will be the touchstone for the market's future direction," one dealer said.
